notes.title: Introducing Merchant Legends: The Founding
notes.content:
Thank you for checking out Merchant Legends.

I have been working on this game for several years, as a hobby project. 
My original idea was to see if I could create a game that had the cute charm of a Game Boy world, but with the depth and complexity of a modern economic simulation game.

I am really enjoying the game so far, and my work on it continues every day. It is a passion for me, having grown up playing games like Final Fantasy, Dark Chronicle, Harvest Moon, Transport Tycoon and more.

When the game finally releases, there will be lots for you to do:


Build a town
Gather resources and automate
Collect recipes and craft goods
Battle monsters and level up
Collect tons of items, weapons and equipment
Explore a hand-crafted 2D pixel open world
Restore a forgotten temple


To support the game, please get your friends to wishlist it, follow my development on Bluesky, check out my Patreon and share your thoughts with me.

Thank you. Prosperity for all!
